__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The guard looks very tough and mean.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dwarf guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He is very dirty, and looks extremely over-worked.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A dwarven mining worker is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dwarf worker miner

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A wraith is awaiting your first move here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wraith

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The storekeeper is very rotund, but looks like a sharp guy.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: There is the Hide & Tooth storekeeper standing here, waiting patiently.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle storekeeper

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Granite Head is covered with flour and grains.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Granite Head, the baker, is waiting for a customer here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle baker

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This scaly creature looks like it is well adapted to it's underground
habitat.  He looks very powerful.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle lizard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The giant is about 8 feet tall, with arms of steel, and looks very strong.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle giant

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The mineworker is very tired, and very dirty, and he has bulging muscles.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dwarf miner

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The mine leader is very big and very strong.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A dwarven mine leader is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dwarf leader

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He is a very skilled surgeon, with hands of steel.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dwarf doctor

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A dwarven peon is awaiting help here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dwarf peon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An unwanted son is here.  You feel sorry for the guy.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dwarf son

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An unwanted daughter is here.  You feel sorry for her.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dwarf daughter

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A man in waiting is here.  He looks nervous and unsure of himself.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle man

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: There is a giant snake here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle snake
